title: Tai and Literature - Literature and Tai (လိၵ်ႈလႄႈတႆး တႆးလႄႈလိၵ်ႈ)
author: Prof. Sai Aung Tun (ၶူးလူင်လုင်းၸၢႆးဢွင်ႇထုၼ်း)
description: Masterly treatise on the literary history, paleography, and cultural significance of the Tai script by eminent historian Prof. Sai Aung Tun. The volume traces the evolution of Lik Tai from Brahmic antecedents into the palm-leaf, folded bark, and modern printed books across Shanland, Yunnan, and Assam.
source: Yangon: Tun Foundation Literary Committee, Archive ID: tai-and-literature-literature-and-tai

sentences.text_roman: to lik tai mi poen kaw kae hoeng ho pak pi tae ma ti lik pra mi
sentences.assamese_script: টাই লিপিৰ ইতিহাস অতি প্ৰাচীন, যাৰ মূল শিপা প্ৰাচীন ব্ৰাহ্মী লিপিৰ সৈতে সংপৃক্ত
sentences.free_translation_en: The Tai script boasts centuries of antiquity, deriving historically from ancient Brahmic writing systems.

sentences.lik_tai: လိၵ်ႈ တူဝ် ယၢဝ်း တီႈ မိူင်း မေႃး လႄႈ လိၵ်ႈ တူဝ် မူၼ်း ပဵၼ် သွင် သၢႆ ၶွင် လိၵ်ႈ တႆး
sentences.text_roman: lik to yaw ti moeng maw lae lik to mun pen sawng sai khawng lik tai

sentences.free_translation_en: The elongated script (*Lik To Yao*) of Mong Mao and the rounded script (*Lik To Mun*) form the two primary orthographic streams.
